spec_location_quirk: Spec-kit tree lives under the component (.specify/specs/...), not a top-level specs/. scripts/spec-sync-hash.sh walks only <dir>/src + components/interfaces/{src,specs}, so the spec .md is not part of the digest for this component. Expected.

specs.notes: Rev 1.0, 128x128B entries, primary my_lba=1@LBA1, backup@last, protective MBR@LBA0.
CRC32 (crc32fast=IEEE) on header and entry array, read and write.
Backup fallback fires on BOTH CorruptTable (CRC) and NoPartitionTable (signature). Blank disk still returns NoPartitionTable after both reads. Fix confirmed present.
size_bytes=0 rest-of-disk supported.
>1 rest-of-disk rejected with LayoutError.
Fixed partitions exceeding usable space rejected.
Protective MBR type 0xEE at LBA 0 (0xEE at gpt.rs:339).
RFC 4122 v4 GUIDs (version at 571, variant at 572). urandom-failure zero-fallback documented in Implementation Notes.
UTF-16LE encode/decode capped at 36 chars.
Configurable ns_id via set_ns_id/get_ns_id (default 1) and config.ns_id.
Sector size fully parameterized; no explicit 512/4096 validation (documented in Impl Notes).
initialize/format/partition_info/num_partitions all provided.
block_device: IBlockDevice receptacle.
initialize_or_format returns (PartitionTable, formatted:bool).
Fixed set of sector writes independent of device size (O(1) vs device size).
Spec backfilled to reality: one ReadSync/recv per sector; ~33 round-trips @512B, O(1) in device size. Spec text matches.
Round-trip offsets identical; no automated test.
CRC- and signature-corrupt primary both fall back to backup; no automated test.
ASCII names preserved on round-trip; no automated test.
Dispatchers wire format_on_init -> initialize_or_format; false path avoids reformat (dispatcher/src/lib.rs:1631,1764).

unspecced.item: Hardcoded primary entry LBA on read
unspecced.notes: try_read_gpt_at(1,2) ignores parsed header.partition_entry_lba (gpt.rs:380); breaks reading externally-created GPTs with a different entry offset. Already in spec Implementation Notes.
Near-zero, non-random GUID if urandom unavailable; in tension with FR-008. Already in spec Implementation Notes.

conflicts.description: SC-001/SC-002/SC-003 and the FR-003 signature-recovery scenario have no automated tests; [dev-dependencies] empty (Cargo.toml:15). Test-coverage gap, not spec drift.
